inspiration.observed_pattern: REPLACE INTO ... SELECT ... RETURNING exposes rows produced by a source-table replacement load.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one existing target, two ordered source rows, and LIMIT 1 so only the replacement row is returned; the independently authored target and source names, values, and domain are new.

fixture_notes: Source row 901 is first by source_rank and replaces the existing target; source row 902 is outside LIMIT 1 and must not be written or returned.
determinism_notes: The fixed source ranks define the LIMIT 1 selection, RETURNING has one row, and the final read is ordered by the primary key. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE replace_limit_target_min (entry_id INT PRIMARY KEY, entry_value VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, generation INT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE replace_limit_feed_min (feed_id INT PRIMARY KEY, entry_id INT NOT NULL, entry_value VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, generation INT NOT NULL, source_rank INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: REPLACE INTO replace_limit_target_min (entry_id, entry_value, generation) SELECT entry_id, entry_value, generation FROM replace_limit_feed_min ORDER BY source_rank, feed_id LIMIT 1 RETURNING entry_id, entry_value, generation

checks.sql: SELECT entry_id, entry_value, generation FROM replace_limit_target_min ORDER BY entry_id
